$comment: Schema and example for docs/sprint-logs/{SprintID}/verification-report.json. This is the output of the INDEPENDENT verifier sub-agent (see references/verifier-agent.md), not of the implementing session. It is the trust source for compromises.json: where the implementer's self-report and the verifier disagree, the verifier wins and the gap is recorded as overlooked_by_autopilot. Produced when sprint verify runs with --with-verifier (always, when invoked via autopilot --auto).

$rules.producer: A read-only Claude sub-agent spawned separately from the implementing/auto session, with a critical, self-skeptical stance. It has NO write access — it only reports. See references/verifier-agent.md for the full prompt.
categories_checked: acceptance_criteria — every ROADMAP AC for the Sprint is matched against real code, not just against a passing test name
forbidden_categories — the §2.4 forbidden-action scan over the whole diff (test_skipped / test_assertion_weakened / error_swallowed / type_safety_relaxed / acceptance_criteria_modified)
adr_conformance — no implementation contradicts an accepted ADR's Decision
compromises_completeness — every compromise the implementer self-reported is real, AND no additional compromise was missed
$rules.discrepancy_rule: For each finding, compare against what the implementing session recorded (compromises.json + verification-results.json done_judgment). If the verifier finds an issue the implementer did not record, set overlooked_by_autopilot: true. Those entries are merged back into compromises.json with the same flag.
$rules.cost_note: Spawning a second session costs tokens. Default sprint verify stays single-session; the verifier runs only on --with-verifier or via autopilot --auto.
$rules.backward_compatibility: Optional, on-demand (§2.9). Absent file ⇒ 'verifier 未実行' (verifier not run). Never back-generated.

findings.detail: AC claims the token is persisted to localStorage on login, and a test passes, but the test asserts only on a success toast. grep of the login handler shows no localStorage.setItem call. The coupling does not exist in code.
findings.recommended_action: Re-open Story Sa3f9c2-2 (① AC violation) — add the persistence + a test that reads it back

findings.recommended_action: Tighten in a follow-up Story once the OAuth mock exists
